rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone’s general reputation, especially whether it is good or bad.

example.english: Their repute in the industry has always been good.
example.traditional: 佢喺業界嘅名聲一向都唔錯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 jip6 gaai3 ge3 ming4 sing1 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 m4 co3

rows.note: Use this when the reputation mainly means how famous or well-known someone is.

example.english: That singer has considerable repute in Japan these days.
example.traditional: 嗰位歌手近排喺日本好有名氣。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 go1 sau2 gan6 paai2 hai2 jat6 bun2 hou2 jau5 ming4 hei3

rows.note: Use this for a reputation based on being trustworthy or reliable, especially for a business, product, or professional.

example.english: This shop has been in business for many years, and its repute has always been excellent.
example.traditional: 呢間舖做生意咁多年，信譽一直都好好。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 zou6 saang1 ji3 gam3 do1 nin4 seon3 jyu6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 hou2
